Applied Machine Learning Engineer
Google / DeepMind Partner Lab
Bengaluru, Karnataka, India (Hybrid)

About the Team:
Our team develops state-of-the-art machine learning models for language and multimodal understanding.

Role:
• Train and deploy large-scale deep learning models using PyTorch, TensorFlow, and Python.
• Work with NLP, GenAI, and transformer architectures in distributed GPU environments.
• Collaborate with research scientists on state-of-the-art algorithms and paper implementations.

Requirements:
• 2-4 years of industry or research experience in machine learning and deep learning.
• Advanced degree: M.Tech or PhD preferred in Computer Science or Artificial Intelligence.
• Strong publications or production deployment track record.
• Fluency in Python, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, and Git.
